basis.note: fixed_flags is the \x1f-separated CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS build_variant assembles for this target (scripts/target_sites.sh flags); fixed_flags_sha256 is the sha256 of that string as rustc receives it. A null sha means the file was absent when this ran.

steps.rule: every loop site its own arm (upper bound; a plan addresses keys)
one arm per distinct site key
drop keys the training profile never entered

oracle.selected_keys_note: `selected_keys_top6` is the result of cap_rule; `selected_keys_topk_per_mark` is the same list, because jev_search.py uses that field when --site-set is omitted.
